questions.text: Match the nerve in the left column with its related statement in the right column
questions.explanation: Great auricular nerve supplies skin over parotid gland. Maxillary nerve carries tooth ache of maxillary teeth. questions.explanation: The glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX) is a mixed nerve with sensory, motor and parasympathetic components reflected in its branches.
